static_traits.name: Zhang Wen
static_traits.family_status: Living with spouse and children, close Family relationships, mutual support
static_traits.social_status: Relationship tension with the supervisor; more inclined to seek professional help for Work issues rather than bothering family
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; without prior psychotherapy or treatment history; no similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Tone neutral; able to clearly describe concrete work situations and feelings; highly cooperative, willing to try cognitive-behavioral experiments; able to conduct self-observation and give examples

basic_info.main_problem: Working over 60 hours per week, constantly worried that excessive Work will lead to being fired; this Fear causes significant stress and Anxiety, affecting Work focus and family rest.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping through counseling to relieve the persistent fear of losing the job, improve mental health and overall well-being, so as to be more focused at work and more relaxed at home.

core_beliefs: I may be fired at any time

special_situations.event: Last month the restaurant held a large event, completed smoothly overall
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not achieved perfection or exceeded targets, it means I am not good enough and my job is not secure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working overtime to invest more time in preparation; taking short breaks and deep breathing during high-pressure periods to suppress Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This does not count, I still have not done enough, I might be fired

special_situations.event: The supervisor shows a serious expression at Work or gives not positive enough feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the supervisor has not explicitly praised me or looks serious, it means my performance is not up to standard and my position is in jeopardy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working harder, extending hours to make up for possible shortcomings, minimizing mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He is dissatisfied with me, I am very likely to be laid off

special_situations.event: Missing a small deadline last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any mistake will bring serious consequences (such as being fired)
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Working overtime to rush tasks, tensely Self-monitoring task progress continuously
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is over; they are going to fire me this time

special_situations.event: Workload increases significantly; works over 60 hours per week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am unable to still perfectly achieve all goals under high workload, then excessive Work will also be seen as incompetence, and I will eventually be fired
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Persistently works overtime to prove themselves; arranges short breaks and deep breathing at work to maintain state
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Overworking will instead lead to being fired; things will be terrible

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized by her supervisor, to maintain job safety and stability
core_conflict.fear: Fearing not being good enough and being negated, eventually being fired and losing security
defense_goal: Maintains performance and reduces the risk of being fired through overtime work and self-control
Trying not to worry the family, keeping problems within a bearable range

object_relations.self_representation: A tense and uneasy employee who could be eliminated at any time
object_relations.object_representation: A supervisor with high Demands, harsh and quick to negate

manifestations: Feeling Restricted choices under a high-pressure Work environment
Works more than 60 hours a week to meet external goals
Self-worth is highly bound to the boss's evaluation and work performance

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Treats the boss's performance targets as absolute standards that must be met
Internalizing the creed 'any mistake will cost me my job' without examination

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on.
manifestations: Excessively self-critical when facing negative feedback or challenging tasks, repeatedly worrying about 'not being good enough'
Not wanting to overly worry the family, tending to handle stress internally

exception_events.target_problem: When missing deadlines, the client usually catastrophizes and believes they will be fired, Anxiety intensified, unable to focus on Work.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After missing a small deadline last week, the client was not fired, and relieved Anxiety through short breaks and deep breathing to continue completing Work.
exception_events.reason: Clue: took the different approach of short breaks and deep breathing; different evidence: also missed small deadlines before but was never warned or fired, and the supervisor never explicitly said the position was at risk.

exception_events.target_problem: Under the pressure of large events, the client usually ignores positive outcomes and persistently worries about being fired.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last month the restaurant's large event was completed smoothly overall; the client successfully organized and advanced the preparation Work, which is inconsistent with their catastrophic prediction.
exception_events.reason: Cue: the smooth outcome of the activity provided contrary evidence; arranging brief rests and deep breathing amid busyness to maintain state helped them complete the key task.

positive_force: Has a supportive family system; willing to confide
Actively seeks professional help and is willing to participate in behavioral experiments
Having basic stress management methods (short breaks, deep breathing)
Still able to complete key tasks under high load (large events going smoothly)
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, negating the positive, mental filtering, and predicting the future
Self-worth highly dependent on external evaluation (boss's goals and feedback)
Long-term high-intensity overtime causes excessive physical and mental load
Relationship tension with the supervisor, negative feedback easily triggers Anxiety
Declining sleep quality and Daily functioning impaired

target_behavior.behavior: High Work-related Anxiety and catastrophic predictions (constantly worrying about being fired)
antecedent: Encountering a difficult task at work
Missing small deadlines or not yet reaching targets
Workload has increased significantly (more than 60 hours a week)
target_behavior.core_reason: Under high-pressure and high-expectation circumstances, internalizing external performance standards as personal value in an undigested way, accompanied by cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, mental filtering, negating the positive and predicting the future, leading to excessive worry about being fired.
target_behavior.function: Escaping the feeling of 'not being good enough' through overtime and overexertion while seeking external recognition and security; relieving immediate Anxiety through short breaks and deep breathing.
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work focus and affected performance; Relationship tension with the supervisor; worsened sleep quality; Daily functioning impaired; ongoing stress and Anxiety.
